description: Defines the LeaveDuration class for handling leave time durations in the OrangeHRM system, including constants for different leave types, getter/setter methods, and logic for validation.

classes.name: LeaveDuration
classes.description: Represents the duration of a leave, including type and optional start/end times, with validation and type-checking methods.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a LeaveDuration object with specified type and optional start/end times.

methods.name: setType
methods.description: Sets the leave duration type with validation.

methods.name: getFromTime
methods.description: Returns the start time if applicable.

methods.name: getToTime
methods.description: Returns the end time if applicable.

methods.name: setToTime
methods.description: Sets the end time with validation.

methods.name: isTypeFullDay
methods.description: Checks if the leave is a full day.

methods.name: isTypeHalfDay
methods.description: Checks if the leave is a half day (morning or afternoon).

methods.name: isTypeHalfDayMorning
methods.description: Checks if the leave is a half day morning.

methods.name: isTypeHalfDayAfternoon
methods.description: Checks if the leave is a half day afternoon.

methods.name: isTypeSpecifyTime
methods.description: Checks if the leave specifies exact times.
